Reason: The radiograph shows bilateral paraspinal masses consistent with extramedullary hematopoiesis, which typically present as well-marginated, lobulated soft tissue masses in the lower thoracic region (caudal to T6) and are associated with skeletal changes like increased rib trabeculation due to marrow expansion in beta-thalassemia.
